text: When the Seriphian told him that he had not obtained this honor by himself, but by the greatness of his city, he replied, "You speak truth; I should never have been famous if I had been of Seriphus; nor you, had you been of Athens."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Themistocles
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
